headline: Marvell lists student roles spanning broadband AMS verification and automated silicon validation
fact: On October 5, Marvell listed related student roles spanning simulation and laboratory validation. The Singapore AMS internship covers broadband-amplifier verification plans, testbenches, simulation analysis and feedback/AGC fundamentals. A Summer 2027 Santa Clara role covers analog validation of amplifiers and optical-interface circuits with automated electrical measurements and Python. An Ottawa 2027 Co-op covers transmitter/receiver measurements, analog/digital feature tests and Python automation for high-speed mixed-signal DSP chips, with an eight-to-twelve-month term.
